Sandbox_DelMines_Capacity_tooltip: How many hits a mine holds when full. Every hit gives one item and takes one from the stock.
Sandbox_DelMines_RegenPerHour_tooltip: Hits added back to every mine each game hour, up to the full stock. 0: a mine refills only when an admin does it.
Sandbox_DelMines_HitTimePercent_tooltip: 100 = as long as breaking a vanilla ore boulder (300 ticks less 10 per Strength level). 50 is twice as fast.
Sandbox_DelMines_XpPerHit_tooltip: Vanilla gives 5 per stone broken out of a boulder.
Sandbox_DelMines_QuarryTable_tooltip: Item:weight pairs separated by semicolons; the chance is weight over the sum. A table that cannot be read falls back to the default.
Sandbox_DelMines_MineTable_tooltip: Item:weight pairs separated by semicolons; the chance is weight over the sum. A table that cannot be read falls back to the default.
